logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.

moments.description: The Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for theft, but Juliana instantly jumps in front of him to defend her husband.
moments.key_dialogue: No! That watch was not in his coat!

moments.description: Gerald gloats about the planted evidence while Juliana furiously accuses him of framing Alexander.
Clarissa glides into the room with a venomous smile, mocking Juliana for defending a broken man.
moments.key_dialogue: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?

moments.description: Clarissa delivers her sadistic demand that Juliana retrieve an emerald ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands.
moments.key_dialogue: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.

moments.description: Alexander desperately begs Juliana not to sacrifice her hands for him, but she tearfully refuses to let them take him.
moments.key_dialogue: I am not letting them take you.

moments.description: Juliana steels her expression and demands to know where the garden is, locking eyes with Clarissa in a brave act of sacrificial defiance.
moments.key_dialogue: Tell me where the garden is.
